english:
To Calwyn Dyn of the Dokkalfar Royal Martial Academy,

I write with a matter of utmost importance. In recent years, the High Court of the Seelie in Ysa has instructed its member Houses to remain neutral in the great war of our age, the conflict between your blessed people and the corrupt might of the Tuatha Deohn. I am aware that this position persists in both Ysa and in the Houses of Prudence and Valor. However, today I come to you with an open hand. The House of Ballads, greatest of the Ysa's children, is willing to offer you its allegiance and services in the coming conflict. Take this letter as a sign of my intent.
